what: Matt Stokes's proof (stokes/erdos-proofs; formal-conjectures PR #7678, open since 2026-10-29, metadata only, no review yet) against DeepMind's statement of Erdős #669, variant k_two: the formal-conjectures solved-PR batch (L3(c) of the claimbox + Lean lane, 2026-11-10). Written by claimbox (claimbox/intake/spec.py) from the target and its pins: every planted statement by a fixed rule, each with the class its rule guarantees or "kernel decides". A pre-registration once committed in cert-machine before any run.
vocabulary: lean-intake spec, claimbox v1 (2026-11-09). Beyond the receiver's v1 words: kind "changed" (a rule that can change the meaning; the kernel decides whether it does) and "type"; expect "kernel decides" (no outcome predicted: the outcome is recorded, never a miss) and "NOT ACCEPTED" (refused by type mismatch, or the statement does not elaborate); "aligned" (F2 ⇒ F1: an aligned planted statement with a part that differs from the canonical's on an instance must be refused); f2.reading and f2.table in place of f2.decider; f2.componentMap "truth-table"
